user_prompt: We need to streamline our component sourcing workflow by simultaneously validating our internal part specifications against supplier certifications and pulling current inventory levels along with vendor capabilities to ensure we're not creating bottlenecks during our quarterly supply chain review.

steps.step_name: Validate our internal part specifications against supplier certifications to ensure compliance and quality standards.
Retrieve current inventory levels and vendor capabilities data for our components to identify potential supply chain bottlenecks.

intent_resolver.reason: The request describes a specific, tactical supply chain review activity (validating specs, checking certifications, pulling inventory levels) rather than a complete end-to-end process lifecycle that any registered skill fully covers.

sub_queries: Validate our internal part specifications against supplier certifications
Pull current inventory levels for our components
Retrieve vendor capabilities and capacity information
